questions.prompt: After we have ____ all of the necessary documents, we will begin our analysis of the data.
questions.explanation: Have compiled là hiện tại hoàn thành; sau have cần quá khứ phân từ để nói việc thu thập tài liệu hoàn tất trước khi phân tích.

questions.prompt: Though he worked very ____ with machines and figures, he was slow and awkward with customers and coworkers.
questions.explanation: Efficiently là trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho worked: làm việc hiệu quả với máy móc và số liệu.

questions.prompt: Although ____ expenses works well when applying for a contract, clients appreciate itemization on their invoices.
questions.explanation: Estimated là phân từ dùng như tính từ bổ nghĩa cho expenses, chỉ các khoản chi phí ước tính.

questions.prompt: The customers usually pay their invoices promptly in order to avoid the ____ of late charges.
questions.explanation: The imposition of late charges cần danh từ imposition sau the và trước of: việc áp dụng phí trả chậm.
questions.sourceNote: Đáp án in ở trang PDF 334 ghi A, nhưng câu ở trang PDF 131 cần danh từ imposition sau the và trước of; đáp án đúng về ngữ pháp là D.

questions.prompt: The customer was angry at the ____ on her invoice.
questions.explanation: Sau the cần danh từ chỉ điều khiến khách hàng tức giận: mistakes là những sai sót trên hóa đơn.
questions.sourceNote: Đáp án in ở trang PDF 334 ghi C, nhưng câu ở trang PDF 131 cần danh từ mistakes để chỉ các lỗi trên hóa đơn; đáp án đúng về ngữ pháp là A.

questions.prompt: The client would appreciate it if the invoice could be sent ____ so he can pay it before the end of the fiscal year.
questions.explanation: Promptly là trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho be sent, nghĩa là hóa đơn được gửi nhanh chóng để kịp thanh toán.
questions.sourceNote: Đáp án in ở trang PDF 334 ghi B, nhưng câu ở trang PDF 131 cần trạng từ promptly bổ nghĩa cho be sent; đáp án đúng về ngữ pháp là A.

readingPassage:
Invoices are an essential part of any business and should be given their due attention. Without invoices, after all, a
business would not receive payment for services rendered. The [16] ____ of the invoice must be stated clearly, that is,
the customer needs to know exactly what he is being charged for and when the payment is due. If a customer
discovers a mistake on the invoice, it should be rectified as soon as possible. If a final charge is much greater than
the original estimate, the reason for this should be explained as clearly and simply as possible on the invoice. Some
businesses [17] ____ a late fee on late payments. In such cases, this must also be made clear on the invoice. Finally,
the invoice must be sent to the customer [18] ____ in order to encourage timely payment.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (16).
questions.explanation: Terms là các điều khoản: phần sau giải thích phải nêu rõ khoản tiền tính cho việc gì và khi nào đến hạn.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (17).
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều businesses cần động từ impose: các doanh nghiệp áp dụng phí trả chậm.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (18).
questions.explanation: Promptly bổ nghĩa cho must be sent; gửi hóa đơn kịp thời sẽ khuyến khích thanh toán đúng hạn.

readingPassage:
Clary Closets
“Making your world more organized.”
Invoice
To: Millicent Pensky
752 Montrose Avenue
Proctorville, VT
Date: November 10, 20—
Initial consultation fee: $75
Organizing four closets: $800
Supplies: $225
Total due: $1100
Thank you for doing business with us.
Please pay by November 30. A 10 percent late fee will be imposed on late payments.

November 15, 20—
Clary Closets
18 North Main Street
Chester, VT
Dear Ms. Clary,
I am writing to dispute the charges on the invoice I recently received from your company. The invoice contained several mistakes. First, I was told that I would not be charged an initial consultation fee if I decided to use your services. Since I did go ahead and hire you to organize my closets, I should not have to pay this fee. Second, the final charge for organizing my four closets was $250 higher than the original estimate. I think this is too much and that I should be charged no more than the original estimate. Finally, I was charged for supplies that you ordered without my authorization. I could have obtained these same supplies myself at a lower price. Since I did not authorize this charge, I think I should pay a lower price for the supplies.
I chose Clary Closets to organize my closets because several of my friends and business associates have been satisfied customers of yours. However, I find it difficult to believe that an organizing business can be so inefficient when it comes to invoices. Please rectify these mistakes and send me a corrected invoice promptly.
Sincerely,
Millicent Pensky

questions.prompt: What did Ms. Pensky hire Ms. Clary to do?
questions.explanation: Thư nói rõ thuê công ty organize my closets, và hóa đơn ghi Organizing four closets.

questions.prompt: According to the terms of the invoice, how much will Ms. Pensky owe if she pays on December 1?
questions.explanation: Hạn trả là 30/11, trả ngày 1/12 chịu thêm 10% của $1100 = $110, tổng cộng $1210.

questions.prompt: How much was the original estimate?
questions.explanation: Phí sắp xếp tủ thực tế là $800, cao hơn dự toán $250, nên dự toán ban đầu là $550.

questions.prompt: The word ordered in the letter is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: Ordered supplies trong thư nghĩa là đặt mua vật tư, gần nghĩa nhất với bought.

questions.prompt: The word rectify in the letter is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: Rectify these mistakes nghĩa là sửa các sai sót; fix phù hợp với yêu cầu gửi hóa đơn đã chỉnh sửa.
